title: Politeness and tone
intro: Grammar can be perfect and still sound rude. Learn how native speakers soften requests, refuse, disagree and complain, so people want to work with you.
introBn: ব্যাকরণ ঠিক হলেও রূঢ় শোনাতে পারে — ভদ্রভাবে বলার কৌশল শিখুন।

units.title: Requests that sound polite
units.idea: Direct imperatives sound rude in English, even with 'please'. Soften with could, would, would you mind, and a reason.
units.ideaBn: বাংলায় 'ফাইলটা পাঠাও' স্বাভাবিক, কিন্তু ইংরেজিতে 'Send the file' কড়া শোনায়। Could you…? দিয়ে বলুন।

formula.name: Soft
formula.pos: Could you send me the file? · Would you mind sending it? · Is there any chance you could…?

formula.name: Softer
formula.pos: I was wondering if you could… · Would it be possible to…?

uses.ex: Could you check this for me?

uses.rule: Would you mind + -ing. Answer 'Not at all' to agree.
uses.bn: mind এর পরে -ing; রাজি হলে Not at all।
uses.ex: Would you mind closing the window? — Not at all.
Could you send it by 5? I need it for the board meeting. Thanks a lot.

uses.rule: Avoid 'Do the needful', 'Revert back', 'Kindly do it'.
uses.bn: এই পুরনো ধাঁচের বাক্য এড়িয়ে চলুন।
uses.ex: Please let me know what you need. I'll get back to you.

traps.right: Could you please take care of this?
traps.bn: do the needful অনেকের কাছে অস্পষ্ট।

traps.wrong: Would you mind to help me?

traps.right: I'll get back to you soon.
traps.why: Revert already means go back; it sounds old.

o: You must send me the report.
Could you send me the report when you have a moment?
drills.a: Could you send me the report when you have a moment?

drills.q: Answer to 'Would you mind waiting a minute?' (yes, you agree)
drills.x: Not at all = I don't mind, I agree.

drills.s: I ___ wondering if you could help me with the slides.

drills.q: আমাকে কি একটু সাহায্য করতে পারবেন?
o: Could you help me for a moment?
drills.a: Could you help me for a moment?

drills.s: ___ I leave a bit early today? I have a doctor's appointment.
Would it be possible ___ the meeting to Thursday?
drills.x: Would it be possible to + base.

units.title: Saying no, disagreeing, complaining
units.idea: Say no without saying 'no': thank, give a reason, offer an alternative. Disagree by agreeing partly first. Complain about the problem, not the person.
units.ideaBn: সরাসরি 'না' না বলে ধন্যবাদ, কারণ আর বিকল্প দিন। দ্বিমত করার আগে আংশিক একমত হন।

formula.name: Refuse
formula.pos: I'm afraid I can't… · I'd love to, but… · Unfortunately…

formula.name: Disagree
formula.pos: I see your point, but… · I'm not sure I agree… · That's true, however…

formula.name: Complain
formula.pos: I'm afraid there's a problem with… · I'd like to report…

uses.ex: I'm afraid we can't offer a discount.
You're right about the cost, but the timing worries me.
I can't do Monday, but how about Tuesday morning?
I didn't receive the file. (not: You didn't send it.)

traps.right: I'm afraid that won't be possible, but I can…
I'm not sure I agree. Have we considered…?
I'm afraid I received the wrong item.

drills.q: Pick the best way to refuse an invitation.
o: I'd love to, but I've got a family event that evening. Maybe next time?
drills.a: I'd love to, but I've got a family event that evening. Maybe next time?

drills.s: ___ , the shipment has been delayed by two days.
I see your point, ___ I think we need more data.

drills.q: দুঃখিত, আমি সোমবার পারব না, কিন্তু মঙ্গলবার কেমন হয়?
o: I'm afraid I can't make Monday, but how about Tuesday?
I can't Monday, but what about Tuesday is?
I'm afraid I can't make Monday, but how about on Tuesday?
drills.a: I'm afraid I can't make Monday, but how about Tuesday?
drills.x: Polite refusal + alternative; no 'on' after how about here.

o: I'm afraid the order I received was incomplete. Could you look into it?
drills.a: I'm afraid the order I received was incomplete. Could you look into it?

drills.s: I'm not ___ that's the best option.

mastery.q: Pick the most natural email line.
o: Could you let me know by Friday? Thanks in advance.
mastery.a: Could you let me know by Friday? Thanks in advance.

mastery.s: Is there any chance you ___ send it today?
mastery.x: Is there any chance you could…

mastery.s: I'd love to help, ___ I'm fully booked this week.

mastery.q: আমি কি একটু জানালাটা খুলতে পারি?
o: Do you mind if I open the window?
Do you mind if I opened the window now?
mastery.a: Do you mind if I open the window?
mastery.x: Do you mind if I + present.

mastery.s: Would you mind ___ that again, please?
I'm ___ there's a mistake on the bill.
